description.value: You + Me Studio is a bright, 864-square-foot shared studio space in the centre of Qualicum Beach's small business district, available for yoga and pilates classes, wellness workshops, creative events, and private rentals. The modern space features white brick walls, nine-foot ceilings, and a turnkey setup with furniture and tech included. Touring cyclists seeking a drop-in wellness or movement class may find it a worthwhile stop in this popular Island cycling corridor.

address.value: #1, 668 Beach Road, Qualicum Beach, BC, V9K 2R1

judgement.verdict_reason: Rental studio space — not walk-in open to the public.

wow_evidence: Rentable shared studio space for classes and private events — not a visitor attraction. KW-PRIVATE correct here.
